title: A Robot as an Interface: Drive, ArmBus and LegBus, and a Fake That Behaves Like the Hardware

questions.question: Why write the interface before the hardware?
options: So that the program is written against the class and the simulator, a fake and a board are interchangeable
So that the hardware can be chosen later, to fit the code
Because an interface runs faster than a concrete class
So that the fake needs no tests
questions.explanation: A program that talks to Drive runs unchanged on a fake, a simulator or a board. The interface is the one place the three have to agree.

questions.question: A base with a limit of 1 m/s was told to go 5 m/s. After 10 s it was doing:
options: 5.000 m/s, as told
0 m/s: an impossible command is refused
questions.explanation: The fake clamps a command to the base's limit, as the hardware does. One that obeyed would let a program rely on speeds no base has.

questions.question: What did a stop at 1 m/s cost in distance for a time constant of 0.2 s?
options: Nothing: a stop is immediate
0.200 m, the speed times the time constant
1.000 m, the speed times one second
questions.explanation: The speed decays with the time constant, and the distance covered while it does is the speed times that constant: 1 m/s times 0.2 s.

questions.question: How long did three joints at 0.5 rad/s take to move 1 rad, and twelve at 2 rad/s?
options: 2.000 s for both
questions.explanation: Each joint moves toward its target at no more than its rate. A radian at 0.5 rad/s is two seconds, and at 2 rad/s half a second.

questions.question: A controller is tuned on a fake that answers instantly. What happens on the real base?
options: It is too slow on the real base
It works: a real base is faster than a fake
The watchdog stops it
It is tuned for a robot that does not exist and overshoots on the real one
questions.explanation: A real base answers in a time constant, 0.2 s here. Gains chosen against an instant answer are too high for a plant that lags.

questions.question: Why are ArmBus and LegBus separate types when they are the same row of joints?
options: So a program cannot hand an arm's targets to a leg
An arm has more joints than a leg
They use different units
The compiler needs two names to link
questions.explanation: Both are a row of joints with targets and rates. Making them different types turns handing one's targets to the other into a compile error.
